request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today", and the test passes: `bin/e2e` ran 1 test and it passed. I also ran the app by hand and checked the endpoint: a new sheet starts on the real date (2026-11-15), and an impossible date (`2025-02-30`) or a blank one is refused with a 400 and leaves the stored date as it was.

The app has no date-dependent features yet; for now the sheet only holds an id. So "every decision and default date uses the sheet's today" isn't tested by anything yet. The server has `SheetRepository.today(id)` for later features to read the date from instead of the real clock.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** a new migration `V2__sheet_today.sql` adds a required `today` date to each sheet. A new sheet gets the real date when it is first loaded, and any sheets that already exist take the date they were created.
- **Server:**
  - The sheet sent to the screen now includes `today`.
  - A new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/today?by=<user>` with body `{"today":"yyyy-MM-dd"}`, checks the date, saves it and returns the updated sheet.
  - A date that doesn't parse is refused with a 400 and nothing is written.
- **Front end:** a new `SheetToday.tsx`, placed under the sheet heading, shows `sheet-today` with a `sheet-today-input` and a `sheet-today-save` button. A refused save shows `sheet-error`, which goes away as soon as the date field is changed or the form is submitted again. After a save, everything else stored under the sheet is re-read, since it may depend on the date.

Changing the date writes nothing to the audit file, because the spec doesn't ask for an audit record.
